newsitem.title: UK: Fritz offers 'fiscal warehousing' in UK.
newsitem.headline: Fritz offers 'fiscal warehousing' in UK.

text.p: Fritz Companies, Inc, is launching a new UK division aimed at promoting "fiscal warehousing" as a mean of reducing import costs, the logistics and freight company said in a statement.

The new firm Fritz CPM (Customs process Management) will provide a full import Customs processing service. A duty management system will be set up for customers to enable goods to be removed to their premises under a simplified, declaration procedure, said Fritz air products director David Merritt.

This will allow customers to call off goods as required and pay duty only when they are used, sold or re-exported. For goods that are destined for re-export outside the EC the importer may be able to avoid payment of any duty, Merritt added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
